_comment: WC2026 SEMI-FINAL (M102: England, QF99 winner, vs Argentina, QF100 winner) -- the CHAOS semi: the two most open, goal-laden profiles left, the stylistic opposite of France-Spain. Nominal bracket orientation is England (home, feeder 99) vs Argentina (away, feeder 100); modelled here with ARGENTINA as home (the favourite) -- immaterial on a neutral venue; the web app flips. MEASURED PROFILES (7 matches each): ARGENTINA (rating 95) -- GF 17 / GA 6; scored THREE in every knockout (3-2 aet, 3-2, 3-1 aet), CONCEDED in every knockout, went deep in two of three; reliable advancement, chaotic texture (the team-specific note, now 3-for-3). ENGLAND (rating 91) -- GF 13 / GA 6; real attack (Kane firing all tournament), leaky defence, BTTS-Yes in 5 of 7, open games (4-2, 3-2, 2-1, 2-1 aet), just survived extra time vs Norway. Class gap ~4 -> Argentina the slight-to-moderate favourite. NOTE: the new tie-breaker rule (break toward the elite defence) does NOT apply -- NEITHER side has an elite defence (both GA 6); this tie is broken on class + firepower, which point the same way (Argentina). Texture: both profiles scream GOALS -- total 2.80, Over 2.5 53%, BTTS-Yes 57% (England scored in 6 of 7; Argentina concedes every knockout), clean sheets LOW (29.5% / 20.6%). Deep tail honest (ET 26.5%, pens 13.1%) -- both sides just played extra time. CONCLUSIVE BOTTOM LINE (graded strictly): THE CALL -- Argentina advance IN 90 MINUTES in an open, both-score game (moderate edge: 59.2/40.8). THE SCORELINE -- Argentina 2-1 (2nd modal at 9.3% and the profile-consistent pick: Argentina always scores 2-3, England always scores). THE MARKETS -- 1X2: Argentina (44.9 vs 28.6); Over 2.5: YES (thin, 53.1%); BTTS: YES (56.8%). Risk: both teams' deep tendencies -- if level late, the 26.5% ET branch spoils the manner; and Kane vs Argentina's soft defence can flip a knife-edge game outright. Home = Argentina (nominal; bracket shows England as home). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).
